verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a public status page with per-service status information, and Personalized Service Health offers a more detailed view of incidents, so the core public status surface exists. Community reports describe it lagging real outages by about an hour and showing services green during incidents, but these show inaccuracy rather than absence, so they lower quality and confidence instead of making the verdict disputed. Missing for 10: documented per-service incident history, documented post-incident reports, and evidence of timely, accurate status reporting during outages.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports

citations.quote: This page provides status information on the services that are part of Google Cloud.
Use Personalized Service Health for a more detailed overview of incidents affecting your Google Cloud projects, including custom alerts, API data and logs.
